svg.title: Mandala Rift — Quarter-turn Pavilion plan, elevation and transverse section
svg.desc: Four receding roof tiers mark the fold exit above the ordinary arcade. A V cut on the threshold identifies the southern pair. The plan is north up, uses metres, and locates two opposed thresholds.
